name: Ramitan! ~Osananajimi wa Tennen Bakunyuu! Itsudemo Dokodemo Ecchi Daisuki!
original_name: らみたん！～幼馴染は天然爆乳！　いつでもどこでもエッチ大好き！
source:
One day I open my eyes, and there she is: a natural-bodied young beauty.

She tells me, she and I are the last two people in this town... Rami-tan and me, all alone together, and we're lovers...

But I have no memory of any of this.

How did this happen?

Day after day of uninhibited, lustful sex in an empty town! Lost memories and the heart of a self-proclaimed girlfriend, what acts will help you understand them both?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ059017.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
